---
title: "Calculator: $Z$-scores"
author: Tom Coleman and Millie Harris
format: html
abstract-title: Summary
abstract: A calculator to provide $Z$-scores for a given significance level $\alpha$. 
filters: 
  - shinylive
---

```{r, setup, include = FALSE}
library("webexercises")
```


```{=html}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Z-Table Calculator</title>

  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 1rem;
      background: #f5f6f8;
      color: #222222;
    }

    .ztc-app {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1000px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-calculator-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-card {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid #dddddd;
      border-radius: 8px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-card-header {
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      color: #ffffff;
      background: #3F6BB6;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-card-body {
      min-height: 220px;
      padding: 1rem;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-form-group {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .ztc-app label {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .ztc-app input[type="number"] {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem;
      border: 1px solid #cccccc;
      border-radius: 5px;
      background: #ffffff;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-test-options {
      padding: 0;
      margin: 1rem 0 0;
      border: 0;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-test-options legend {
      margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-radio-option {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.45rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-radio-option input {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      width: 17px;
      height: 17px;
      margin: 0;
      accent-color: #3F6BB6;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-input-help {
      margin-top: 0.35rem;
      color: #555555;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-input-error {
      min-height: 1.4em;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
      color: #b00020;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-result-panel {
      display: flex;
      min-height: 188px;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-result-heading {
      margin: 0 0 0.3rem;
      color: #3F68B6;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-result-value {
      margin: 0.2rem 0 0.4rem;
      color: #3F68B6;
      font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 2.5rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .ztc-app .ztc-interpretation {
      max-width: 500px;
      margin-top: 0.4rem;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .ztc-app input:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(63, 104, 182, 0.38);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 700px) {
      .ztc-app .ztc-calculator-row {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .ztc-app .ztc-card-body {
        min-height: auto;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      body { padding: 0.5rem; }

      .ztc-app .ztc-card-body {
        padding: 0.9rem;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>

<main class="ztc-app">
  <div class="ztc-calculator-row">

    <section class="ztc-card" aria-labelledby="ztc-input-heading">
      <div class="ztc-card-header" id="ztc-input-heading">
        Input parameters
      </div>

      <div class="ztc-card-body">
        <div class="ztc-form-group">
          <label for="ztc-alpha">Significance level (α):</label>
          <input
            id="ztc-alpha"
            type="number"
            value="0.05"
            min="0.001"
            max="0.999"
            step="0.001"
            inputmode="decimal"
            aria-describedby="ztc-alpha-help ztc-alpha-error">

          <div id="ztc-alpha-help" class="ztc-input-help">
            Enter a value from 0.001 to 0.999.
          </div>

          <div
            id="ztc-alpha-error"
            class="ztc-input-error"
            role="alert"
            aria-live="assertive">
          </div>
        </div>

        <fieldset class="ztc-test-options">
          <legend>Test type:</legend>

          <label class="ztc-radio-option">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="ztc-test-type"
              value="one">
            <span>One-tailed</span>
          </label>

          <label class="ztc-radio-option">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="ztc-test-type"
              value="two"
              checked>
            <span>Two-tailed</span>
          </label>
        </fieldset>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="ztc-card" aria-labelledby="ztc-results-heading">
      <div class="ztc-card-header" id="ztc-results-heading">
        Z-score results
      </div>

      <div class="ztc-card-body">
        <div
          class="ztc-result-panel"
          role="status"
          aria-live="polite"
          aria-atomic="true">

          <h2 class="ztc-result-heading">Critical Z-score</h2>

          <div id="ztc-z-score" class="ztc-result-value">
            ±1.9600
          </div>

          <div id="ztc-interpretation" class="ztc-interpretation">
            For a two-tailed test with α = 0.05, the critical values are
            −1.9600 and 1.9600.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

  </div>
</main>

<script>
(function() {
  "use strict";

  const app = document.querySelector(".ztc-app");
  if (!app) return;

  const alphaInput = app.querySelector("#ztc-alpha");
  const error = app.querySelector("#ztc-alpha-error");
  const zScoreOutput = app.querySelector("#ztc-z-score");
  const interpretation = app.querySelector("#ztc-interpretation");

  /*
    Inverse standard normal CDF using Peter J. Acklam's rational
    approximation. It is accurate enough for the displayed four decimals.
  */
  function inverseNormalCDF(probability) {
    if (probability <= 0) return -Infinity;
    if (probability >= 1) return Infinity;

    const a = [
      -3.969683028665376e+01,
       2.209460984245205e+02,
      -2.759285104469687e+02,
       1.383577518672690e+02,
      -3.066479806614716e+01,
       2.506628277459239e+00
    ];

    const b = [
      -5.447609879822406e+01,
       1.615858368580409e+02,
      -1.556989798598866e+02,
       6.680131188771972e+01,
      -1.328068155288572e+01
    ];

    const c = [
      -7.784894002430293e-03,
      -3.223964580411365e-01,
      -2.400758277161838e+00,
      -2.549732539343734e+00,
       4.374664141464968e+00,
       2.938163982698783e+00
    ];

    const d = [
       7.784695709041462e-03,
       3.224671290700398e-01,
       2.445134137142996e+00,
       3.754408661907416e+00
    ];

    const lowerThreshold = 0.02425;
    const upperThreshold = 1 - lowerThreshold;
    let q;
    let r;

    if (probability < lowerThreshold) {
      q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(probability));

      return (((((c[0] * q + c[1]) * q + c[2]) * q + c[3]) * q +
        c[4]) * q + c[5]) /
        ((((d[0] * q + d[1]) * q + d[2]) * q + d[3]) * q + 1);
    }

    if (probability > upperThreshold) {
      q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(1 - probability));

      return -(((((c[0] * q + c[1]) * q + c[2]) * q + c[3]) * q +
        c[4]) * q + c[5]) /
        ((((d[0] * q + d[1]) * q + d[2]) * q + d[3]) * q + 1);
    }

    q = probability - 0.5;
    r = q * q;

    return (((((a[0] * r + a[1]) * r + a[2]) * r + a[3]) * r +
      a[4]) * r + a[5]) * q /
      (((((b[0] * r + b[1]) * r + b[2]) * r + b[3]) * r +
      b[4]) * r + 1);
  }

  function getTestType() {
    const selected = app.querySelector(
      'input[name="ztc-test-type"]:checked'
    );

    return selected ? selected.value : "two";
  }

  function validateAlpha() {
    const alpha = Number(alphaInput.value);
    let message = "";

    if (!Number.isFinite(alpha)) {
      message = "Enter a valid numerical significance level.";
    } else if (alpha < 0.001 || alpha > 0.999) {
      message = "The significance level must be from 0.001 to 0.999.";
    }

    error.textContent = message;
    alphaInput.setAttribute("aria-invalid", message ? "true" : "false");

    return message ? null : alpha;
  }

  function formatAlpha(alpha) {
    return Number(alpha.toFixed(3)).toString();
  }

  function update() {
    const alpha = validateAlpha();
    const testType = getTestType();

    if (alpha === null) {
      zScoreOutput.textContent = "Not available";
      interpretation.textContent =
        "Enter a valid significance level to calculate the critical Z-score.";
      return;
    }

    const cumulativeProbability = testType === "one"
      ? 1 - alpha
      : 1 - alpha / 2;

    const z = inverseNormalCDF(cumulativeProbability);
    const formattedZ = Math.abs(z).toFixed(4);
    const formattedAlpha = formatAlpha(alpha);

    if (testType === "one") {
      zScoreOutput.textContent = formattedZ;
      interpretation.textContent =
        `For a one-tailed test with α = ${formattedAlpha}, ` +
        `the upper-tail critical Z-score is ${formattedZ}. ` +
        `For a lower-tailed test, use −${formattedZ}.`;
    } else {
      zScoreOutput.textContent = `±${formattedZ}`;
      interpretation.textContent =
        `For a two-tailed test with α = ${formattedAlpha}, ` +
        `the critical values are −${formattedZ} and ${formattedZ}.`;
    }
  }

  alphaInput.addEventListener("input", update);

  app.querySelectorAll('input[name="ztc-test-type"]').forEach(
    function(radio) {
      radio.addEventListener("change", update);
    }
  );

  update();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

```
